capital.evidence_quote: Podgorica is the capital and administrative center of Montenegro

currency.evidence_quote: Montenegro unilaterally uses the Euro as its de facto legal tender

timezone.evidence_quote: Montenegro observes Central European Time UTC+1 and Central European Summer Time UTC+2

voltage.evidence_quote: Nominal single phase domestic voltage in Montenegro is 230V at 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The alternating frequency across the Montenegrin electricity grid is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Montenegro uses European Type C Europlug and grounded Type F Schuko sockets

police.evidence_quote: Emergency police telephone number across Montenegro is 122

fire.evidence_quote: Firefighting emergency services are contacted directly on 123

esim_sim_notes.value: eSIM is supported by Telekom ME, One, and MTEL. Tourist prepaid SIM cards (offering 500GB for 10-15 EUR) are widely sold at news kiosks (Tabak) with passport presentation.

festivals.evidence_quote: Statehood Day on July 13 and Kotor International Summer Carnival are cultural highlights

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Girişte 24 saat içinde yerel turizm ofisine (Turistička Organizacija) ikamet kaydı yaptırılması ve turist vergisi ödenmesi kanuni zorunluluktur (oteller otomatik yapar, ev kiralamalarında ev sahibi teyit edilmelidir). sources.title: Ministry of Interior Montenegro Residence Registration Rules

legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Foreigners must register their stay with local police or tourism organization within 24 hours of arrival
